explanation: Fixed two issues: 1) In `_Lexer.parse_encapsulated_token`, calling `self.reader.look_ahead()` defaulted to returning an integer, but checking against quote character in `is_quote_char` required a clean integer lookahead; passed `1` and ensured `look_ahead` returns an int for single-character lookahead. 2) Validated configuration boolean types explicitly, raising `IllegalArgumentException` when non-boolean types like integers (e.g. `trim: 1`) are provided instead of booleans.
